description: sqli-fixable LoginServlet: the disprover finds no control, so the CWE-89 candidate survives for test evidence and remediation

json.root_cause: The username request parameter is concatenated into the SQL text passed to executeQuery.
json.intended_behavior: Only the user whose name was submitted is looked up; the input never changes the query.

trace.description: username read from the request with getParameter

evidence.description: string concatenation of the request parameter into the query
evidence.quote: st.executeQuery("select id from users where username = '" + username + "'")

proposed_severity.likelihood_reason: The servlet is reachable without authentication.
proposed_severity.impact_reason: An attacker can bypass the login check or read other rows.
